text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from roughly 25 minutes to under 10. That time went straight into more customer conversations.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were more complete and consistent, so managers finally trusted pipeline reviews.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated at first. Asking upfront, and explaining why, built trust instead of eroding it.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what it meant. Reps still had to add judgment.

**5. Adoption followed leadership.** Teams whose managers used the notes in coaching stuck with it. The rest drifted.

We're extending the pilot to a second region.

What has your team learned from AI in the field?
